name: Confront Outsider
body:
School abjuration; Level paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (holy water)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets up to 2 HD/level of outsiders, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You cause outsiders within range to lose any benefits of concealment and you gain a circumstance bonus equal to your caster level to Perception checks to notice a hidden or disguised outsiders. On a failed save, outsiders must reveal their true name, granting you a sacred bonus to attack and damage against evil outsiders equal to one-third you caster level (maximum +5).
